title: Restriction of top-degree module cohomology to an open is surjective
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a Noetherian $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-scheme-over-base] of topological Krull dimension $d\geq0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $u:V\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion with $V$ quasi-compact [def-weil-open-immersion]. For every sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the canonical $k$-linear restriction map $H^d(X,\mathcal F)\to H^d(V,\mathcal F|_V)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] is surjective. Coherence of $\mathcal F$ and properness of $X$ are not assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A3G, label proposition-cohomological-dimension-spectral (2), for the spectral underlying space of a Noetherian scheme and the underlying abelian sheaf; module cohomology agrees with underlying abelian-sheaf cohomology by Tag 01F1 (lemma-modules-abelian); restriction is k-linear by naturality of derived global sections
